officialInventory.summary: Parks and reserves are managed by the Office Ivoirien des Parcs et Réserves (OIPR) under Loi n° 2002-102, whose Annexes 1-2 are the official list as of 2002 (8 national parks, 6 reserves with creating instrument and area). Later creations are by decree (2013-2026), traced via FAOLEX/LEAP, the national CBD CHM and Council-of-Ministers communiqués. Forêts classées (~231-234, SODEFOR) were not enumerated. oipr.ci was not used.

statedCounts.quote: 8 parcs nationaux et 7 réserves naturelles couvrent une superficie totale de 2 075 866 ha
234 Forêts Classées couvrent une superficie totale de 4 196 000 ha
16 réserves botaniques d’une superficie totale de 198.418 hectares

notEnumerated.reason: List too large; no official list found (NBSAP gives 231, 6NR 234).
Names not listed in sources seen.
RNVs are created ad hoc by decree; no consolidated list found.

gaps: Annex areas date from 2002; boundaries of most parks/reserves were redefined by 2018 decrees whose new areas were not extracted.

Decree numbers for the Grand-Béréby MPA (2022), Eden de Agnéby-Tiassa RNV (2025) and SOGB RNV (2026) were not verified from the Journal Officiel; only Council-of-Ministers communiqués/press were seen.
Whether the 'Zone périphérique de protection du Parc de Taï' still exists as a separate reserve after 2018 is unknown.
The OIPR website (oipr.ci) was not used; OIPR's current count of '15 parks and reserves' appears only in press reports.
Proposed MPA sites from the 2020 Council-of-Ministers communication have no defined boundaries in sources seen.
areaKm2 values were converted from hectares (1 km² = 100 ha) where the cited source gives hectares; source figures are quoted in notes where they conflict.
